newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly down in slow trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower in lacklustre trade on Friday, as selling in distant months late in the day reversed early gains, traders said.
Prices were up to 1.1 yen per kg lower. The only contract to end firmer was the spot September, which was up 0.1 yen. The benchmark February contract was down 0.5 yen to 139.8 yen.
Volume was thin as most private investors retreated to the sidelines ahead of the long weekend and the spot expiry next Tuesday.
"Sentiment remains bearish as rubber stocks are expected to rise further after recent gains," a trader said.
